authority.browser: presentation, contract validation, and request composition only

roleCatalog.defaultScopeBehavior: Use the backend value when present. Null or absent never implies the first allowed scope. A non-null default outside allowedScopeTypes rejects the catalog.
roleCatalog.failureBehavior: Missing, malformed, unavailable, or unknown role metadata disables role and scope mutation. Production never substitutes local fixture policy.

scopeRules.global: must be explicit and server-authorized; null never means Global
scopeRules.executiveManagement: H1 returns GLOBAL as defaultScope and the only allowed scope, and H1 validates it
scopeRules.mutationValidation: H3 offers only scope types present in the selected H1 policy; H1 remains final authority

request: userType (optional descriptive metadata; H3 omits it)
createUser.consumerFailureBehavior: Any missing or invalid response invariant is rejected before provisioning success is displayed.
createUser.temporaryPasswordExpiry: exactly 72 hours, owned and enforced by H2
createUser.semanticState: ACTIVE is account state; PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED blocks normal application access until password mutation completes

firstPasswordChange.session: password-change-required restricted session cookie plus CSRF token

authentication.mutationResult: PASSWORD_CHANGED or PASSWORD_RESET_COMPLETED; H2 revokes sessions and H3 clears runtime state and returns to login

administratorMfa.setup: POST /v1/management-platform/identity/users/{userReference}/mfa-authenticators/setup returns one-time shared secret and otpauth URI
administratorMfa.reset: POST /v1/management-platform/identity/users/{userReference}/mfa-authenticators/reset returns replacement one-time shared secret and otpauth URI
administratorMfa.qrRendering: local qrcode library; exact Central PMS otpauth URI; no external QR service
administratorMfa.panelClose: destroy secret, URI, and generated QR from component state and DOM, then refresh status

developmentIsolation.identityScenarioResolver: requires import.meta.env.DEV and an explicit isolated test-harness enable flag

remainingExternalBoundaries: Native Parking device ownership, device enrollment, and native application authorization remain outside the Management Platform consumer.
APT terminal ownership, terminal enrollment, and device-bound authorization remain outside the Management Platform consumer.
